content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Organisational units Central Offices Centre for Student Advisory & Career Services Psychological counselling Psychological counselling In your daily life as a student you will find yourself faced with many challenges, not only academically but also personally. Some students may experience periods of difficulty, problems with concentration, feelings of being overwhelmed and/or anxiety. Support for such problems is available from our psychological counsellors. In a confidential setting, your psychological counsellor will talk through your problems with you and help you to find solutions. Although we do not offer psychotherapy, we can provide information about suitable forms of therapy. Don't hesitate to ask for an individual counselling appointment. It is gratis and confidential. Common reasons for counselling include fear of exams and tests, chronic procrastination, difficulties with self-organisation, concentration problems, learning problems, frequent feelings of being overwhelmed, dissatisfaction with studies, chronic exhaustion, persistent depression, anxiety, recurrent conflicts in relationships, social difficulties, crisis situations and addiction problems. Appointment We offer individual appointments online or offline. Please let us know, what you prefer. Please note that offline appointments are at the moment only offered at Campus Treskowallee. For an individual appointment, please contact us via e-Mail psychologische.beratung@htw-berlin.de We will send you available time slots. Thank you! Materials and Handouts Materials and handouts in English: Relaxation and mindfulness throughout the semester Social Self-Confidence Materials and handouts in German can be found on the German version of this website.
